therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: reduction of cellular proliferation in Barrett's epithelium
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: change in Ki67 biomarker expression from baseline to week 12

results.effect_size: Ki67 increased from 1539 to 1575 cells/mm² in treatment vs 1556 to 1864 cells/mm² in placebo
results.target_engagement_evidence: CCK2R expression decreased by -1.19 log-fold change vs placebo, elevated serum gastrin levels (242.6 vs 43.6 pmol/L at week 4)
biomarker_changes: Serum gastrin elevated throughout treatment (242.6-146.8 pmol/L vs 43.6-96.4 pmol/L placebo)
Plasma CgA reduced during treatment (1.8-3.9 nmol/L vs 8.8-16.9 nmol/L placebo)
CCK2R expression reduced by -1.19 log-fold change
PTGS2 expression increased by 0.31 log-fold change
DCLK1 expression reduced by -0.34 log-fold change
